title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency
abstract: arXiv:2611.30205v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped language models reuse one block of weights T times per token, trading parameters for test-time depth, but autoregressive decoding then pays T sequential passes per token. Self-speculative decoders recover 2-10x for a single request, yet their gains fade as requests share a GPU, and current practice is to speculate less as load grows. We show that what fails under load is the layout of speculative work, not speculation. In concurrent decoding the unit of cost is the row, one request advancing on one loop, which reads that loop's key-value (KV) cache once; additional positions inside a row are nearly free. Pipelined schedules such as the wavefront place every speculative position on a different loop, hence in a row of its own, so each token is still read T times. translated_title: PackLoop：并发场景下循环语言模型的行打包自推测解码
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型对每个 token 重复使用同一权重块 T 次，以参数换取测试时的深度，但自回归解码随后需要为每个 token 进行 T 次顺序传递。自推测解码器能为单个请求带来 2-10 倍的加速，然而当多个请求共享一个 GPU 时，其收益会减弱，目前的常见做法是随着负载增长而减少推测。我们证明，在高负载下失效的是推测工作的布局方式，而不是推测本身。在并发解码中，成本的基本单位是“行”，即一个请求在一个循环上的推进，它会读取该循环的键值（KV）缓存一次；同一行内额外的位置几乎不产生额外成本。诸如波前调度之类的流水线调度将每个推测位置放在不同的循环上，因而各自占据一行，导致每个 token 仍需被读取 T 次。我们提出 PackLoop，其建立在一个原则之上：只在本就无论如何都会被读取的行内进行推测。深循环累积多个位置并将它们作为一个块在同一行内推进……
tldr: PackLoop 发现并发负载下自推测解码失效的原因是推测工作的布局而非推测本身，并提出只在必然要读取的 KV 缓存行内打包推测位置，使循环语言模型在高并发下仍保持加速收益。
en_tdlr: PackLoop shows that self-speculative decoding fails under load due to the layout of speculative work rather than speculation itself, and preserves speedups for looped language models by packing speculation into KV-cache rows that are read anyway.
